best_idea: Keep a presentation or game clock within a capped step of real time by nudging it a fraction of the gap each loop, so one lag spike becomes a small step spread over several frames rather than a single jump.
decision_why: The server sim must stay on a fixed step: a variable game dt makes fight outcomes depend on machine timing and breaks server-verified kills and fight replay (rows 1, 18, 19); the nudge only fits a client display clock.
acceptance: Not built for the server; if a client-only display clock takes the nudge, a client test asserts that after a 1 s stall displayed time never passes real time and no frame advances it by more than 0.2 s.
